title: Universal plant and animal eDNA metabarcoding using Nanopore sequencing
author: Lucas Esteban Wange
materials: Discard the supernatant using a P1000 pipette
Air-dry beads for 5 min on the magnet.
Typically we aim for 300 fmol total input
Start the BioScanRT pipeline as sepcified in github

steps.title: Prepare Proteinase K Storage Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the Proteinase K solution for use.

substeps.instruction: Add 1,040 µl Proteinase K Storage Buffer to each Proteinase K (20 mg) tube.
Mix and store at -20ºC.

steps.title: Sample Homogenization and Digestion
steps.instruction: Mechanically homogenize and digest the sample material.

substeps.instruction: Add up to 50 mg of material to a bead beating tube containing DNA/RNA Shield.
Mechanically homogenize on a vortex mixer at maximum speed for 3 minutes.
Add 20 µl Proteinase K, mix well, and incubate at room temperature (RT) for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge the sample at 10,000 x g for 1 min; transfer up to 400 µl of lysate to a new tube.
Add 400 µl Quick-DNA MagBinding Buffer to 400 µl digested sample and mix by pipetting or inverting 10 times.
Add 33 µl of MagBinding Beads (or 30 µl if using a repeater pipette).
Place on a magnetic rack until beads separate from the solution.
Remove from rack, add 500 µl Quick-DNA MagBinding Buffer, and return to the magnetic rack; discard supernatant using a P1000 pipette.
Remove from rack, add 500 µl DNA Pre-Wash Buffer, mix by pipetting, and return to the magnetic rack; discard supernatant using a P1000 pipette.
Remove from rack, add 900 µl g-DNA Wash Buffer, mix by pipetting, and return to the magnetic rack; discard supernatant using a P1000 pipette. Repeat this wash step two more times.
Add 40 µl of DNA Elution Buffer to each sample.
Place on the magnetic rack until beads separate and transfer the eluted DNA to a new tube.

steps.title: Multiplex PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification of the target regions.

substeps.instruction: Add 19.5 µl eDNA to one well per sample (6.5 µl per technical triplicate).
Add 30 µl 2x Qiagen Multiplex PCR mix to each well.
Mix with a multichannel pipette and distribute 16.5 µl into a total of 3 wells per sample.
Seal microwell plates with thick plastic seals (e.g., MicroAmp clear Adhesive Film).
Set up a No Template Control (NTC): 10 µl 2x Qiagen Multiplex PCR mix and 6.5 µl H2O.
Set up a Positive Control: 10 µl 2x Qiagen Multiplex PCR mix and 6.5 µl diluted control DNA (max 1 ng total).
Add 3.5 µl of forward reverse barcode mix per well (or 1.75 µl forward and 1.75 µl reverse mix). Use each combination once per experiment.
Run PCR cycling: Initial denaturation 95ºC for 15m; 35 cycles of [95ºC 30s, 55ºC 1m 30s, 72ºC 1m 30s]; final extension 72ºC for 15m; store at 12ºC.

steps.title: PCR Product Cleanup and Normalization
steps.instruction: Clean and normalize the amplicon pools.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate SPRI bead solution to RT and vortex.
Add 1.5x volume of beads (e.g., 90 µl beads for 60 µl sample), mix 10 times, and incubate for 5 min.
Place on magnet until supernatant clears; wash twice with 100 µl freshly prepared 80% EtOH.
Remove from magnet, add 30 µl ddH2O to beads, mix 10 times, and incubate for 5 min.
Place on magnet until supernatant clears and transfer DNA to a new tube.
Measure 1 µl of cleaned PCR product using Qubit HS DNA kit.
Calculate DNA amount for normalization. Add normalization solution (1 µl SPRI Beads + 19 µl Bead Binding Buffer) at a 1:1 ratio to each sample.
Add isopropanol at a 1:1 ratio (e.g., 20 µl for 20 µl PCR).
Mix thoroughly (Sample + Normalization solution + Isopropanol, 60 µl total) and incubate for 10 min at RT.
Place on magnet (~5 min), remove supernatant, wash with 75 µl 80% EtOH, and air dry for 30 seconds.
Resuspend each row in 50 µl PCR grade H2O.
Pool all samples (excluding controls) into one 1.5 ml tube and incubate for 5 minutes.
Place on magnet and transfer supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: End-Repair and A-Tailing
steps.instruction: Prepare the amplicon pool for ligation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare master mix per library: 1.5 µl Klenow fragment exo- (5 U/µl), 2 µl T4 PNK (10 U/µl), 0.5 µl dATP (10mM), 4 µl T4 DNA ligase buffer (10x), and 2 µl Reaction booster (Total 10 µl).
Add 10 µl of master mix to each 30 µl amplicon pool, mix by pipetting, and spin down.
Incubate at 37ºC for 30m, then 65ºC for 5m, then store at 4ºC.

steps.title: Ligation Adapter Attachment
steps.instruction: Ligate adapters to the end-repaired DNA.

substeps.instruction: Spin down Ligation Adapter (LA) and Quick T4 Ligase; place on ice.
Thaw Ligation Buffer (LNB), Elution Buffer (EB), and Short Fragment Buffer (SFB) at RT, then place on ice.
In a 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube, mix: 60 µl Endrepaired Amplicon pool, 25 µl LNB, 10 µl NEBNext Quick T4 DNA Ligase, and 5 µl LA (Total 100 µl).
Mix by gently pipetting, spin down, and incubate for 10 min at RT.

steps.title: Library Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the ligated library using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend AMPure XP Beads (AXP) and add 40 µl to the reaction; mix by flicking.
Incubate for 5 min at RT.
Spin down, place on magnet, and pipette off supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 250 µl Short Fragment Buffer (SFB) and discard supernatant.
Spin down, place on magnet, and remove residual supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 15 µl Elution Buffer (EB).
Pellet beads on magnet until eluate is clear; remove 15 µl of eluate for Qubit HS DNA measurement.

steps.title: Library Quantification and Molarity Calculation
steps.instruction: Calculate the molarity of the library for loading.

substeps.instruction: Use formula: Molarity (nM) = concentration (ng/µl) / (660 * mean fragment length (bp) * 1e6). Assume mean fragment length ~500 bp for COI and ITS2.
Calculate volume for 50 fmol: (50 fmol * 660 * mean fragment length * 1e6) / concentration (ng/µl).
Prepare 50 fmol in 12 µl of Elution Buffer (EB).

steps.title: Flow Cell Priming
steps.instruction: Prepare and prime the MinION flow cell.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Sequencing Buffer (SB), Library Beads (LIB), Flow Cell Tether (FCT), and Flow Cell Flush (FCF) at RT, then place on ice.
Prepare priming mix: 1170 µl FCF, 5 µl BSA (50 mg/ml), and 30 µl FCT.
Open MinION lid, slide flow cell under clip, and press down firmly.
Open priming port cover clockwise. Use a P1000 pipette set to 200 µl to draw back 20-30 µl of buffer to remove air bubbles.
Load 800 µl of priming mix into the priming port and wait 5 min.
Load an additional 200 µl of priming mix into the priming port, avoiding air bubbles.

steps.title: Library Loading and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Load the prepared library onto the flow cell and start the run.

substeps.instruction: Prepare loading mix in a 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tube: 37.5 µl SB, 25.5 µl LB, and 12 µl DNA library (50 fmol).
Mix the library gently by pipetting just prior to loading.
Lift SpotON sample port cover and add 75 µl of the prepared library dropwise.
Replace SpotON cover and close the priming port; place the light shield on the flow cell.
Run Flow Cell check.
Start MinKnow run with standard parameters for Ligation Sequencing Kit V14; disable basecalling and select 'include small fragments' if library size <200bp.
Start the BioScanRT pipeline via the corresponding github repository.
